theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid d → Euclid d) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (v₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → v₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ V → Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ v₀) → ∃ (V₁ O : Set (Euclid d)) (H : Euclid d → Euclid d), IsOpen V₁ ∧ IsOpen O ∧ v₀ ∈ V₁ ∧ V₁ ⊆ V ∧ Φ v₀ ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 H O ∧ H '' O = V₁ ∧ (∀ w ∈ O, Φ (H w) = w) ∧ ∀ w ∈ O, Surjective (fderiv ℝ H w)
